text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As the Halloween fever dies down and
the city returns to normal, Misaki finds herself a little saddened.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハロウィンが終わり、街がいつもの様子に戻ろうとしているところを、
ミサキが寂し気に眺めていた。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Hey there, {0}.
I haven't seen you since the Halloween party.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あら、{0}じゃない。
ハロウィンパーティー以来ね。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Yup! It sure was!
Ahem... Looking at it from a child's perspective, of course.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
すごく楽しかったわ！
……こほんっ、
まっ、
子供目線でって意味だけどね？

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh.
There's something sad about seeing the city
go back to normal like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーあ、
こうやって街がいつも通りになるのを見るのって、
ちょっぴり寂しいわね……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
I hear adults talk about this feeling sometimes.
What did they call it again... Ennui, I think?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが、
大人が言う
あんにゅい？　
な気分なのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Wait. Why are you glowing?!
Enough with the tricks! Halloween's over already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
なんかアンタ光ってるわよ！？
もうハロウィンは終わったんだから、
イタズラはやめなさいよー！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: The time has come! Off to town we go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
街に繰り出すわよー！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Why? Isn't it obvious? Because it's Halloween!
Listen up. A real adult knows that
Halloween's the day you go wild in town!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでって……
ハロウィンに決まってるでしょー？
いい？　
大人になるとね、
ハロウィンの日は街で大騒ぎするのよ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Or that's what they said on TV, anyway.
Nevertheless! Today, I become an adult!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……まぁ、テレビで見ただけだけど……
でも、
今日でアタシも大人の仲間入りね！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Mom sure pulled a fast one on me, though.
Asking you to accompany me since it's dangerous by myself and all that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一人じゃ危ないからって、
お母さんがアンタを呼んだのは予想外だったけど……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
But don't go acting like you're in charge of me or anything!
I'd be just fine on my own!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言っておくけど、
保護者ぶらないでよね！
アタシは一人でも大丈夫なんだから！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: But hey. You're here, so I'll let you take the lead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあでも、
どうせ付いて来るならちゃんとエスコートしてちょうだい！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Trick or treat! Cheers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
トリックオアトリート！　
かんぱーーーい！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
I'll drink to that!
Oh, hey! Let's take a pic!
We'll get a bunch of likes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえーい！　
あ、写真撮ろ写真！
いいねいっぱい貰えるよ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're [i]really[/i] going wild.
So this is how adults spend the night...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいハイテンション……
これが大人の夜なのね……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Hey, look over there! Cutie spotted!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
みてみてー！　
あの子超かわいいー！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what's going o—
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
な、
なに？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Hey there! Has anyone ever told you how cute you are?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちはー！　
あなた可愛いねー！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Y-you mean me?! Really?
U-umm... Thank you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ア、
アタシ！？　
……ですか？
あ、あの、その、
ありがとうございます……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Wow, wow! She's all flustered! What a beaut!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャー！　
恥ずかしがってるー！　マジ美少女～！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Errr, ummm....
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
うぅっ……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
I-is this how adults have fun?
It's kind of... intimidating.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これが大人のノリ？　
なんか、
怖い……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Awww, give her a break
You've got her cowering behind her big bro!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やめろよー、
怖がってお兄ちゃんの後ろに隠れちゃったじゃーん。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, we won't bite. Take a pic with us! ♪
The whole world'll be screaming about how cute you are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
怖くないよ～、
私と一緒に写真撮ろ～♪
きっとみんな可愛い～って言ってくれるよ～！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
I, uhhh...
I'd rather... Ummm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、いや、
あの、
アタシ……
その……
うぅぅ。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Oh...
text_block_list.orig_text: あっ……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Awww. Off she goes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーあ、
行っちゃった～

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: *sigh* What was all that about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
なんなのあのテンション……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
I-I wasn't scared or anything, by the way!
Just a little taken aback!
text_block_list.orig_text:
べ、
別に怖くてひっついてたわけじゃないから！
ちょっとびっくりしただけよ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Thanks, though... I appreciate it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど、
ありがと……
連れ出してくれて。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, look!
The cosmetics store over there's running an event!
Let's go check it out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
ほら！　
あっちのコスメショップで何かイベントやってるわ！
行ってみましょう！

text_block_list.name: Female Staff
text_block_list.text:
Gather around, everyone! We're currently holding
an apple bobbing contest! And anyone who succeeds will win
themselves some Halloween-exclusive cosmetics!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
ただいま当店では、
ダックアップル成功者の方に、
ハロウィン限定コスメをプレゼントするイベントをやっていまーす！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That sounds fantastic!
Maybe I should give it a shot...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へー、
限定コスメなんて素敵じゃない！
やってみようかなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you've never bobbed for apples?
It's a staple of Halloween. You throw apples in a tub
full of water, then try to pick them out with your teeth.
choice_data_list: I bet you can pull it off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ダックアップル知らないの？　
ハロウィンじゃ有名なゲームよ。
水に浮かべたリンゴを、手を使わずに口で取るの。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Hmph.
Only a kid couldn't do something that simple!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんっ、
このくらいのことができなきゃ、
大人って言わないわ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying!
So let's get to it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
当たり前でしょ！
　
さ、大人の遊びをはじめるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! I'd like to participate in the contest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません、
ダックアップルに挑戦させてください！

text_block_list.name: Female Staff
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, aren't you cute? ♪
Give it your best now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
可愛いお客さん♪
頑張ってね～

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you really gonna participate?
From what I've seen, no one's been able to pull it off yet.
There's no way a kid can break the streak.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
キミ挑戦するの？　
さっきから見てたけど、
成功した人全然いないし、
子供には無理だと思うよ？

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare treat me like a kid!
Just watch. I'll do it and prove you wrong!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシは子供じゃないわ！　
成功させて、
それを証明してみせるんだから！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Okay. Let's do this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
行くわよ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: *inhale* Hmph!
text_block_list.orig_text:
す～……
んっ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
I'll get one on my first tr— Urgh!
I forgot that the apples won't stay still
when they're in the water!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一発で成功させるわよ～、
あぐっ！
……うっ、
水に浮かんだリンゴがくるくる回って捕まらない！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
But still! I'm a proper adult! A fine lady! This won't stop me!
Hm? That apple's a little bit smaller... Jackpot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
アタシは大人の女！　
このくらい余裕よ！
ん？　
ちょっと小さ目のリンゴ……
これよ！！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Phew! I did it! I got one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ぷはっ、
やったわっ！　
取ったぁ！

text_block_list.name: Female Staff
text_block_list.text: Wow! Congratulations!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わー！　
おめでとうございまーす！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Yoooooo! She did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおおおっ！　
すげええええ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Heh! They're all singing my praises!
And no doubt ready to accept that I'm a proper adult, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
みんながアタシを称賛してる！
アタシのこと、
立派なレディだって認めたみたいね。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: I did go and prove it beyond a shadow of a doubt, after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
大人ならこれくらいできて当然よね！

text_block_list.name: Female Staff
text_block_list.text:
You did such a good job.
I'm sure your parents would be proud.
text_block_list.orig_text: 小さいのによく頑張ったわね～

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
Right? Seeing such a little kid give it her all is just,
like, so inspiring!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
小さい子が頑張ってる姿ってのは、
なんか、こう感動しちまうよな！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Hm. I'm just going to assume I misheard all that. Yup!
And hey. Now I've got some exclusive cosmetics. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
なんか聞こえた気がするけど……
気のせいよね！
けどこれで、
限定コスメをゲットできるのね♪

text_block_list.name: Female Staff
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
These are for adults, though, so you should gift them
to either your mom or your sister if you have one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おめでとう！　
でもこれ大人用のコスメだから、
お姉さんかお母さんにでもプレゼントしてね。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
What?! No way!
What was all that effort even for?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーっ！
　
そんなー！　
せっかく頑張ったのに～！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Argh, I can't believe this!
Someone turn me into an adult already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなのってないわよ～！
あ～、はやく大人になりたーーい！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Poor thing, having that effort go to waste.
She'll become an adult whether she likes it or not though,
so there's no real need for her to rush it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あははははっ！　
せっかく頑張ったのにねー
その内いやでも大人になるんだから、背伸びすることないんだけど。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
As for you, welcome back.
That was a special little \"dream\" I conjured up for you.
Did you like it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたもお疲れ様。
いま見たのは、
あたし特製の『夢』みたいなものよ。
楽しめたかしら？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Have to say though, young adults sure like
to go wild on Halloween.
No surprise that Misaki was so flustered.
text_block_list.orig_text:
にしても、
若者のハロウィンってのは凄いわね～
そりゃ、ミサキちゃんも萎縮しちゃうわね……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Much as she wants to act otherwise, she's still a kid.
So don't let her get hurt, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どんなに大人ぶってても、
あの子はやっぱり子供なんだから、
ちゃんと守ってあげるのよ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Be a gentleman. Just like she wants you to be.
text_block_list.orig_text: ミサキちゃんが憧れる紳士としてね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Anyway. See you around. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: それじゃあ、またね～♪

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
Huh? What happened to the Halloween cosmetics...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅん……
あれ？　
ハロウィンコスメは……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh. I think I'm still half-asleep.
What sort of fine lady sleeps in the middle of the street?
Come on, you. Let's get up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
アタシ寝ぼけてるみたい……
路上で寝ちゃうなんてレディとしてダメだったわね。
ほら、アンタも起きなさい。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that I had a Halloween-related dream just now.
Probably because this year's was so fun...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか、
夢の中でもハロウィンをしていた気がするわ。
今年のハロウィンは楽しかったから……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
I'm a bit sad that it's over, but well...
That's just more reason to make next year's even better.
text_block_list.orig_text:
終わっちゃったのはやっぱりちょっと寂しいけど、
それなら、
来年はもっと楽しめばいいのよね。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
I'll teach you even more about the joys of Halloween next year!
You better be ready for a boatload of fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}！
来年はもーっとハロウィンの楽しさを教えてあげるから、
覚悟しときなさい！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having made the most of Halloween this year,
Misaki vowed to enjoy next year's even more.
All with a beaming smile appropriate for her age.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハロウィンを全力で楽しんだミサキ。
来年は、今年以上に楽しいハロウィンにすると意気込み、
年相応に笑うのだった。
